title: Micro-Computers and Micro-Processors
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a computer network that is made up of several LANS."
A CAN network is a computer network that is made up of several LANS.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the use of a processor where data is moved from one particular input to an output, without necessarily requiring any processing."
Throughput and routing is the use of a processor where data is moved from one particular input to an output, without necessarily requiring any processing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the set of machine language instructions that a processor can understand."
Instruction set is the set of machine language instructions that a processor can understand.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are an example of a LAN connector, as are hubs and switches."
Wireless access points are an example of a LAN connector, as are hubs and switches.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used by a person (or other system) to communicate with a computer."
I/O devices are used by a person (or other system) to communicate with a computer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the destination of most bit level logical operations."
The C (carry) flag is the destination of most bit level logical operations.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used with the stack only."
PUSH and POP instructions are used with the stack only.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are an important aspect of the decision- making process in the programming."
Jump - Conditional jumps are an important aspect of the decision- making process in the programming.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the functional part of a microcomputer, using all of the various parts of the larger system."
The microprocessor is the functional part of a microcomputer, using all of the various parts of the larger system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are considered devices that make instant decisions and carry out multiple commands with the help of the decisions."
The microprocessors are considered devices that make instant decisions and carry out multiple commands with the help of the decisions.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used for different types of applications."
Microcontrollers and Microprocessors are used for different types of applications.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible for any microprocessor to function properly."
The two memories are responsible for any microprocessor to function properly.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the low-order address and the third byte is the high-order address."
Note that the second byte is the low-order address and the third byte is the high-order address.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the extremely powerful processors used in high-end servers, such as Sun's SPARC, IBM's Power, or Intel's Itanium."
Less common are the extremely powerful processors used in high-end servers, such as Sun's SPARC, IBM's Power, or Intel's Itanium.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an eclectic collection of signals that control how the processor communicates with the rest of the system."
The control bus is an eclectic collection of signals that control how the processor communicates with the rest of the system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the standard way to interact with the computer."
A keyboard and mouse are the standard way to interact with the computer.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of several CAN computer networks."
A MAN computer network is made up of several CAN computer networks.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the Motorola microprocessor, which is in Apple Macintosh and Power Macintosh systems."
An alternative to the Intel-style microprocessor is the Motorola microprocessor, which is in Apple Macintosh and Power Macintosh systems.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a computer design model that uses a processing unit and a single separate storage structure to hold both instructions and data."
Von Neumann architecture is a computer design model that uses a processing unit and a single separate storage structure to hold both instructions and data.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a binary pattern designed inside a microprocessor to perform a specific function."
An instruction is a binary pattern designed inside a microprocessor to perform a specific function.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to present the processed data (information) to an end-user or operator."
Output devices are used to present the processed data (information) to an end-user or operator.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an area that demands high performance from microcontroller chips to perform complex mathematical tasks."
Signal processing is an area that demands high performance from microcontroller chips to perform complex mathematical tasks.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a signal that causes the computer to alter its normal flow of instruction execution."
An interrupt is a signal that causes the computer to alter its normal flow of instruction execution.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the conceptual design and fundamental operational structure of a computer system."
Computer architecture is the conceptual design and fundamental operational structure of a computer system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to hold the address of the external data (since DPTR is a 16-bit register it can address 64KByte locations: 216 = 64K)."
The DPTR register is used to hold the address of the external data (since DPTR is a 16-bit register it can address 64KByte locations: 216 = 64K).
fib: ______ is called using the LCALL or the ACALL instruction.
subroutine
A subroutine is called using the LCALL or the ACALL instruction.
______ is a control memory that uses registers to temporarily store data.
Random access memory
Random access memory is a control memory that uses registers to temporarily store data.
______ is a special processor chip or circuit board that assists the processor in performing specific tasks.
coprocessor
A coprocessor is a special processor chip or circuit board that assists the processor in performing specific tasks.
______ is an exception; it adds 16-bit data directly in register pairs.
instruction DAD
The instruction DAD is an exception; it adds 16-bit data directly in register pairs.
______ are used for input and output.
Peripherals
Peripherals are used for input and output.
______ is a group of computers and other devices, such as printers and modems, connected to each other.
network
A network is a group of computers and other devices, such as printers and modems, connected to each other.
______ is an essential hardware component of a personal computer.
computer memory board
A computer memory board is an essential hardware component of a personal computer.
______ is an area where specialised processor units are frequently employed.
Processing of digital graphics
Processing of digital graphics is an area where specialised processor units are frequently employed.
______ is used to store data for transport to another computer or for backup in case of computer failure.
External memory
External memory is used to store data for transport to another computer or for backup in case of computer failure.
______ is used to hold the result of any addition operation.
(the accumulator)
Register A (the accumulator) is used to hold the result of any addition operation.
______ is a digital computer whose processing unit consists of one or more microprocessors, and includes storage and input- output facilities.
microcomputer (micro)
microcomputer
A microcomputer (micro) is a digital computer whose processing unit consists of one or more microprocessors, and includes storage and input- output facilities.
______ is a network of electronic components connected by cables.
computer system
A computer system is a network of electronic components connected by cables.
______ is the fifth generation Intel microprocessor.
Pentium
The Pentium is the fifth generation Intel microprocessor.
______ is the sixth generation of Motorola microprocessors.
PowerPC family
The PowerPC family is the sixth generation of Motorola microprocessors.
______ are the signals or data received by the system, and outputs are the signals or data sent from it.
Inputs
Inputs are the signals or data received by the system, and outputs are the signals or data sent from it.
______ is a generic call instruction supported by many 8051 assemblers.
ACALL
ACALL is a generic call instruction supported by many 8051 assemblers.
______ is a low-level language that contains a short word or "mnemonic" for each individual command that a microcontroller can follow.
assembly language
An assembly language is a low-level language that contains a short word or "mnemonic" for each individual command that a microcontroller can follow.
______ is a network that is made up of computers that cover small areas, such as a home network or a small office.
LAN
A LAN is a network that is made up of computers that cover small areas, such as a home network or a small office.
______ is a Low Power (3.3V) Version of MC68LC040.
MC68040V is a Low Power (3.3V) Version of MC68LC040.
______ are used in accessing external memory data.
MOVX and MOVC
MOVX and MOVC are used in accessing external memory data.
______ is used to include the carry bit in the addition process.
ADDC instruction
The ADDC instruction is used to include the carry bit in the addition process.
______ is an 8-bit register that is a part of arithmetic/logic unit (ALU).
accumulator
The accumulator is an 8-bit register that is a part of arithmetic/logic unit (ALU).
______ is an 8086 with several support functions such as clock generator, system controller, interrupt controller, and direct memory access (DMA) controller integrated on the chip.
The 80186 is an 8086 with several support functions such as clock generator, system controller, interrupt controller, and direct memory access (DMA) controller integrated on the chip.
______ is a collection of wires on which electrical signals pass between components in the system.
bus
A bus is a collection of wires on which electrical signals pass between components in the system.
______ is the set of all addressable memory locations.
address space
The address space is the set of all addressable memory locations.
